purpose: Bounded cache-only semantic validation of the J1 standard-TTFT/request-average-TPOT ledger against pinned HELIX execution records.

reference_semantics.average_tpot: last Increment completion minus first Increment completion, divided by output_tokens-1
reference_semantics.workload_rule: all requests must pass applicable limits (classification target=1.0)
reference_semantics.accounting_alignment: reconstructed standard endpoints plus the same explicit fixed/queue charge used by J1; no evaluator H or recovered blocking correction is added to the execution reference

reported_metrics: maximum standard TTFT and average TPOT diagnostics
